title: High-frequency spectral asymptotics and homogenization for quasiperiodic operators
summary: We study the spectral asymptotics of elliptic operators with quasiperiodic coefficients by exploiting projections from higher-dimensional periodic functions. Using the framework of two-scale convergence adapted to cut-and-project quasiperiodic structures we establish that, in the low-frequency (homogenization) regime, the spectrum converges to that of a homogenized operator with effective coefficients determined by a cell problem on the higher-dimensional torus.
